title.en: The Car That Made No Sound

caption.en: A quiet car, an empty lot, and the road nobody built before.
caption.ko: 조용한 차, 빈 주차장, 아무도 깔지 않던 길.

moral.en: The laughter was short. The road stayed long.

cta.en: One company a day. Watched from a distance.

narration.en: The car was quiet. No engine turned over.
narration.ko: 그 차는 조용했다. 시동 걸리는 소리가 없었다.
